findings.evidence: The declarations occur at SimpleReflections.lean:64, 92, and 150 with only `(P : RootPairing …)` assumptions, while WeylGroup.lean is titled “Permutation actions of Weyl groups” and already contains `weylGroupToPerm_ofIdx_apply` at line 101 and related action identities at lines 111 and 118.
findings.fix: Move all three declarations to `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/WeylGroup.lean`; keep the word and generation declarations in `SimpleReflections.lean`.
findings.issue: `ofIdx_reflectionPerm`, `ofIdx_inv` (line 92), and `ofIdx_weylGroupToPerm` (line 150) require no base or finiteness/crystallographic assumptions and are generic Weyl-group API, so placing them in `SimpleReflections` makes broadly useful results depend on a later generation topic.

summary: Three base-independent Weyl-group identities are placed in the simple-reflection generation file instead of the earlier generic WeylGroup module.
